sources.highlight: Saturday Sports: LIV Golf shuts down; Russian hockey teams banned from World Juniors
sources.after: LIV Golf is shutting down after four years and billions of dollars of Saudi investment. Also, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney says Russian teams cannot play in the World Junior Hockey Tournament.
